rule: A stale price.updated delivered around price.deleted must not bring the price back
setup: INSERT INTO products(id,active,name) VALUES ('prod_1',true,'Pro'); INSERT INTO prices(id,product_id,active,unit_amount,currency) VALUES ('price_1','prod_1',true,1000,'usd')
invariant: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM prices WHERE id='price_1' AND active=false) = 0
notes: SQL transliteration of the webhook handler; covers bounded SQL orders only, not HTTP or Stripe.
